test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Gopika Varma won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2019 in which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Mohiniyattam__. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gopika Varma** is indeed a prominent figure in the world of **Mohiniyattam,** a classical dance form hailing from **Kerala, India**.
 
• In **2019**, she was honored with the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award **for her exemplary contributions to Mohiniyattam.
 
• **Mohiniyattam **is revered as one of the eight Indian Classical Dance forms recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• The term "Mohiniyattam" derives from "Mohini," signifying a woman who captivates and enchants observers.
 
• Gopika Varma's mastery of Mohiniyattam has earned her numerous accolades, including the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award,** Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Akademi Award, and the prestigious title of Kalaimamani.
 
• Her dedication to the art form has not only garnered recognition but has also helped in preserving and promoting the rich cultural heritage of Mohiniyattam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kathak **is indeed one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance. Its origins are traditionally traced back to the traveling bards of ancient northern India known as Kathakars or storytellers.
 
• **Bharatanatyam**, is another classical Indian dance form that originated in Tamil Nadu. 
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a classical dance form that originated in the state of Andhra Pradesh, India. It derives its name from the village of Kuchipudi, located about 65 kilometers from Vijayawada, in Andhra Pradesh.
